```
1. **PlaceChest→TileObject.CanPlace 全链移植（placeBuriedChest）**：旧「2×2 全空+双腿实心」过严。
```

```
157	  ];
158	  let best: [Theme, number] = scores[0];
159	  for (let i = 1; i < scores.length; i++) if (best[1] < scores[i][1]) best = scores[i];
160	  return best[0];
161	}

163	// ---------- 家具/陈设放置 ----------
164	/** 底锚(bottom)/顶锚(top)放置 framed 物件;帧 = style*fw*18 步长 */
165	function placeFurniture(st: TileStore, key: string, x: number, y: number, style = 0, anchor: 'bottom' | 'top' = 'bottom'): boolean {
166	  const t = TILE_BY_KEY[key];
167	  if (t === undefined) return false;
168	  const d = TILE_DEFS[t];
169	  const fw = d.vanilla?.fw ?? 1;
170	  const w = d.w ?? fw, h = d.h ?? (d.vanilla?.fh ?? 1);
171	  const topY = anchor === 'bottom' ? y - (h - 1) : y;
172	  for (let dx = 0; dx < w; dx++) {
173	    for (let dy = 0; dy < h; dy++) {
174	      if (!st.inBounds(x + dx, topY + dy) || st.flags[st.idx(x + dx, topY + dy)]) return false;
175	    }
176	  }
177	  // 样式基偏移:权威布局表(FurnitureStyle.ts,竖排/换行族与通用横排统一)
178	  const sheet = d.vanilla?.sheet ?? -1;
179	  const [bx, by] = furnitureStyleBase(sheet, style, fw);
180	  for (let dx = 0; dx < w; dx++) {
181	    for (let dy = 0; dy < h; dy++) {
182	      st.setTileSilent(x + dx, topY + dy, t, bx + dx * 18, by + dy * 18);
183	    }
184	  }
185	  return true;
186	}

188	/** 雕像(2×3,style*36 步长);STATUES_WITH_TRAPS 命中 → 邻近飞镖陷阱+接线 */
189	function placeStatue(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number, idx: number): boolean {
190	  const [sheet, style] = STATUE_LIST[idx];
191	  const tile = sheet === 349 ? STATUE_349 : STATUE_105;
192	  if (!tile || !st.inBounds(x + 1, y - 2)) return false;
193	  for (let dx = 0; dx < 2; dx++) {
194	    for (let dy = -2; dy <= 0; dy++) {
195	      if (st.flags[st.idx(x + dx, y + dy)]) return false;
196	    }
197	  }
198	  // 雕像帧换行（Place2xX case 105，cs:39716-39720）：每行 55 列——
199	  // frameX=(style%55)*36、frameY=floor(style/55)*54（与 StatuesPass 同实现；
200	  // 此前单轴 style*36，style≥55 越界错位）
201	  const row = Math.floor(style / 55);
202	  for (let dx = 0; dx < 2; dx++) {
203	    for (let dy = 0; dy < 3; dy++) {
204	      st.setTileSilent(x + dx, y - 2 + dy, tile, (style - row * 55) * 36 + dx * 18, row * 54 + dy * 18);
205	    }
206	  }
207	  if (STATUES_WITH_TRAPS.has(idx)) placeStatueTrap(st, x, y);
208	  return true;
209	}

211	// ---------- 画(RandHousePicture cs:35336 / Desert cs:35286) ----------
212	const PIC_240 = [26, 28, 20, 21, 22, 24, 25, 33, 34, 35, 76, 77, 78, 79, 82, 96, 98, 100];
213	const PIC_245 = [0, 3, 5, 6, 14, -1, 19, 20, 21]; // -1 → 15+rng(4)
214	const PIC_246 = [1, 30, 31, 32, 33, 34, 35, 36];
215	function randHousePicture(rng: RNG): [string, number] {
216	  let n = rng.int(0, 3);
217	  if (n >= 3 && rng.int(0, 1) !== 0) n = rng.int(0, 2);
218	  if (n <= 1) return ['v_240_wall_hangings_3x3', PIC_240[rng.int(0, 17)]];
219	  if (n === 2) {
220	    let s = rng.int(0, 8);
221	    if (s === 0 && rng.int(0, 2) !== 0) s = rng.int(0, 8);
222	    const style = s === 5 ? 15 + rng.int(0, 3) : PIC_245[s];
223	    return ['v_245_paintings_2x3', style];
224	  }
225	  return ['v_246_paintings_3x2', PIC_246[rng.int(0, 7)]];
226	}
227	function randHousePictureDesert(rng: RNG): [string, number] {
228	  const n = rng.int(0, 3);
229	  if (n <= 1) return ['v_240_wall_hangings_3x3', [63, 64, 65, 66, 67, 68][rng.int(0, 5)]];
230	  if (n === 2) return ['v_245_paintings_2x3', 7 + rng.int(0, 1)];
231	  return ['v_242_paintings_6x4', 37 + rng.int(0, 5)];
232	}

234	// ---------- 原版 GenAction 链 1:1 解释器(Modifiers.cs / Actions.cs 逐条核实) ----------
235	// 三条权威语义(旧实现全部踩错,修复根因):
236	//  · Dither(p)(Modifiers.cs:621-635):p 是【失败率】——NextDouble() >= p 才放行,
237	//    即 Dither(0.85) 通过率仅 15%。旧实现把 0.85 当通过率(< 0.85 即过),七主题
238	//    蚀变量级整体取反(C1)。
239	//  · Blotches(Modifiers.cs:92-152,Apply :131-152):每点【先丢 1 掷】,再
240	//    NextDouble() < chance 决定是否成斑;成斑再掷 4 次(Next(1-minX,1)/Next(0,maxX)/
241	//    Next(1-minY,1)/Next(0,maxY))并把后续链应用到随机矩形(会外溢房外);未成斑
242	//    则原点继续。旧实现用自制哈希值噪声替斑,分布与掷骰数都不对(C2)。
243	//  · 链序 = 掷骰序:Dither/Blotches 永远排在 OnlyTiles/OnlyWalls 之前
244	//    (各 *HouseBuilder.cs AgeRoom),对房间矩形内每格都掷,失败短路后不耗 RNG(C3);
245	//    墙动作的 worldSurface 二选一按【房间】room.Y 判定(WoodHouseBuilder.cs:36 /
246	//    IceHouseBuilder.cs:32),非逐格。
247	type ChainStep =
248	  | { k: 'dither'; p: number }                                            // Modifiers.Dither
249	  | { k: 'blotches'; minX: number; maxX: number; minY: number; maxY: number; chance: number } // Modifiers.Blotches
250	  | { k: 'onlyTiles'; types: number[] }                                   // Modifiers.OnlyTiles(Modifiers.cs:238)
251	  | { k: 'onlyWalls'; types: number[] }                                   // Modifiers.OnlyWalls(Modifiers.cs:216)
252	  | { k: 'skipTiles'; types: number[] }                                   // Modifiers.SkipTiles(Modifiers.cs:392)
253	  | { k: 'isEmpty' }                                                      // Modifiers.IsEmpty(Modifiers.cs:539)
254	  | { k: 'offset'; dx: number; dy: number }                               // Modifiers.Offset(Modifiers.cs:603)
255	  | { k: 'setTileKeepWall'; tile: number }                                // Actions.SetTileKeepWall(Actions.cs:272)
256	  | { k: 'setTile'; tile: number }                                        // Actions.SetTile(Actions.cs:203)
257	  | { k: 'clearTile' }                                                    // Actions.ClearTile(Actions.cs:155)
258	  | { k: 'clearWall' }                                                    // Actions.ClearWall(Actions.cs:171)
259	  | { k: 'placeWall'; wall: number }                                      // Actions.PlaceWall(Actions.cs:516)
260	  | { k: 'stalagtite' }                                                   // ActionStalagtite → WorldGen.PlaceTight
261	  | { k: 'vines'; min: number; max: number; vine: number };               // ActionVines
262	
263	/** GenAction.Apply 第 i 步 @ (x,y),失败短路返回 false(不执行后续步骤、不耗 RNG) */
264	function applyChain(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, steps: ChainStep[], i: number, x: number, y: number): boolean {
265	  if (i >= steps.length) return true;
266	  const s = steps[i];
267	  switch (s.k) {
268	    case 'dither':
269	      // Modifiers.cs:630-635:NextDouble() >= _failureChance 才 UnitApply
270	      return rng.next() >= s.p && applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
271	    case 'blotches': {
272	      rng.next();                                                    // 丢 1 掷(Modifiers.cs:132)
273	      if (rng.next() < s.chance) {                                   // 成斑判定(:133)
274	        const x0 = rng.int(1 - s.minX, 0);                           // Next(1-minX, 1)(:136)
275	        const x1 = rng.int(0, s.maxX - 1);                           // Next(0, maxX)(:137)
276	        const y0 = rng.int(1 - s.minY, 0);                           // Next(1-minY, 1)(:138)
277	        const y1 = rng.int(0, s.maxY - 1);                           // Next(0, maxY)(:139)
278	        let ok = true;                                               // flag |= !UnitApply(:140-145)
279	        for (let dx = x0; dx <= x1; dx++) {
280	          for (let dy = y0; dy <= y1; dy++) {
281	            if (!applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x + dx, y + dy)) ok = false;
282	          }
283	        }
284	        return ok;
285	      }
286	      return applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);                // 未成斑原点继续(:148)
287	    }
288	    case 'onlyTiles': {
289	      if (!activeAt(st, x, y)) return false;                         // !active → Fail(:245)
290	      const t = st.type[st.idx(x, y)];
291	      return s.types.includes(t) && applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
292	    }
293	    case 'onlyWalls':
294	      // Blotches 扇出可外溢房外 1 格,读前兜底(房间本体 InWorld 10 边距本已安全)
295	      return st.inBounds(x, y) && s.types.includes(st.wall[st.idx(x, y)])
296	        && applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
297	    case 'skipTiles': {
298	      if (!activeAt(st, x, y)) return applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y); // !active 放行(:399)
299	      return !s.types.includes(st.type[st.idx(x, y)]) && applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
300	    }
301	    case 'isEmpty':
302	      return !activeAt(st, x, y) && applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
303	    case 'offset':
304	      return applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x + s.dx, y + s.dy);
305	    case 'setTileKeepWall':
306	      // Actions.cs:272-301:清块保墙(墙由本仓墙段独立处理)+ type + active,恒成功
307	      st.setTileSilent(x, y, s.tile);
308	      return applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
309	    case 'setTile':
310	      st.setTileSilent(x, y, s.tile);
311	      return applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
312	    case 'clearTile':
313	      st.setTileSilent(x, y, 0);
314	      return applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
315	    case 'clearWall':
316	      st.setWallSilent(x, y, 0);
317	      return applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
318	    case 'placeWall':
319	      st.setWallSilent(x, y, s.wall);
320	      return applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
321	    case 'stalagtite':
322	      placeTight(st, rng, x, y);                                     // ActionStalagtite 恒 UnitApply
323	      return applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
324	    case 'vines': {
325	      // ActionVines.cs:21-35:len=Next(min,max+1);逐格向下铺到实心;i>0 才算成功
326	      const len = rng.int(s.min, s.max);
327	      let placed = 0;
328	      for (let k = 0; k < len && st.inBounds(x, y + k) && !activeAt(st, x, y + k); k++) {
329	        st.setTileSilent(x, y + k, s.vine, 0, 0);
330	        placed++;
331	      }
332	      return placed > 0 && applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
333	    }
334	  }
335	}
336	
337	/** WorldUtils.Gen + Shapes.Rectangle(Shapes.cs Rectangle.Perform):x 外层 / y 内层 */
338	function genRect(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, steps: ChainStep[], ox: number, oy: number, w: number, h: number): void {
339	  for (let x = ox; x < ox + w; x++) {
340	    for (let y = oy; y < oy + h; y++) applyChain(st, rng, steps, 0, x, y);
341	  }
342	}

344	// ---------- 钟乳石(WorldGen.PlaceTight 1:1) ----------
345	/** PlaceUncheckedStalactite 的冰分支(cs:38377-38405):上方 ∈{147,161,163,164,200}
346	 *  才放置;其余名单(石/苔/沙等)在地下屋场景上方是主题块,恒静默返回 */
347	function placeUncheckedStalactite(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number, preferSmall: boolean, variation: number): void {
348	  if (!solidAt(st, x, y - 1) || activeAt(st, x, y) || activeAt(st, x, y + 1)) return;
349	  const above = st.type[st.idx(x, y - 1)];
350	  if (above !== SNOW147 && above !== ICE161
351	    && above !== TILE_BY_KEY['v_163_corrupt_ice_block']! && above !== sheetTile(164)
352	    && above !== TILE_BY_KEY['v_200_crimson_ice_block']!) return;
353	  // 冰族专属列（GetDesiredStalagtiteStyle :38800-38808 重定型）：147/161→0、
354	  // 163→594、164→540、200→648——曾全写 fx0 冰柱列（163/164/200 错列）
355	  const base = above === SNOW147 || above === ICE161 ? 0
356	    : above === TILE_BY_KEY['v_163_corrupt_ice_block']! ? 594
357	    : above === sheetTile(164) ? 540 : 648;
358	  if (preferSmall) {
359	    st.setTileSilent(x, y, STALACTITE, base + variation * 18, 72);
360	  } else {
361	    st.setTileSilent(x, y, STALACTITE, base + variation * 18, 0);
362	    st.setTileSilent(x, y + 1, STALACTITE, base + variation * 18, 18);
363	  }
364	}
365	
366	/** WorldGen.PlaceTight(cs:38329-38351):231 幼虫(及 shimmer,生成期无来源)短路,
367	 *  其余【恒先掷 2 次】Next(2)/Next(3) 再走 PlaceUncheckedStalactite——名单外静默
368	 *  返回但掷骰照耗(沙漠/花岗岩/大理石的 ActionStalagtite 行因此也要走这里) */
369	function placeTight(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, x: number, y: number): void {
370	  if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) return;
371	  const i = st.idx(x, y);
372	  if (st.flags[i] !== 0 && st.type[i] === LARVA231) return;
373	  const preferSmall = rng.int(0, 1) === 0;
374	  const variation = rng.int(0, 2);
375	  placeUncheckedStalactite(st, x, y, preferSmall, variation);
376	}
377	
378	/** AgeRoom 七主题蚀变:逐主题把原版 WorldUtils.Gen 链逐条转录(行号 = 各
379	 *  *HouseBuilder.cs AgeRoom)。Dither/Blotches 语义见 applyChain 头注(C1/C2/C3) */
380	function ageRoom(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, r: Rect, theme: Theme, def: ThemeDef): void {
381	  // Blotches(scale=2)→ minX=maxX=minY=maxY=2(Modifiers.cs:95-100)
382	  const B2 = (chance: number): ChainStep => ({ k: 'blotches', minX: 2, maxX: 2, minY: 2, maxY: 2, chance });
383	  // 墙段收尾:room.Y > worldSurface 时清墙、否则铺墙——按【房间】整体二选一
384	  // (WoodHouseBuilder.cs:36 / IceHouseBuilder.cs:32 的三元表达式在链构造时求值)
385	  const wallTail = (surfaceWall: number): ChainStep[] => [
386	    { k: 'skipTiles', types: SKIP_AGING_TILES },
387	    r.y > gs.worldSurface ? { k: 'clearWall' } : { k: 'placeWall', wall: surfaceWall },
388	  ];
389	
390	  if (theme === 'wood') {
391	    // ① 蛛网(WoodHouseBuilder.cs:30-35):W*H/16 次,每处 2×2 矩形跑
392	    //   Dither(0.5)+Blotches(2,2,chance 0.3)+IsEmpty+SetTile(51)
393	    const count = Math.floor(r.w * r.h / 16);
394	    for (let c = 0; c < count; c++) {
395	      const x = rng.int(1, r.w - 2) + r.x;
396	      const y = rng.int(1, r.h - 2) + r.y;
397	      genRect(st, rng, [{ k: 'dither', p: 0.5 }, B2(0.3), { k: 'isEmpty' }, { k: 'setTile', tile: COBWEB }], x, y, 2, 2);
398	    }
399	    // ② 墙侵蚀(WoodHouseBuilder.cs:36):Dither(0.85)+Blotches()+OnlyWalls(27)+
400	    //   SkipTiles(画族)+清墙/铺土墙 2
401	    genRect(st, rng, [
402	      { k: 'dither', p: 0.85 }, B2(0.3), { k: 'onlyWalls', types: [def.wall] }, ...wallTail(2),
403	    ], r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
404	    // ③ 第三段(WoodHouseBuilder.cs:37,曾整体缺失 C4):Dither(0.95)+
405	    //    OnlyTiles(30,321,158)+ClearTile——剥掉木/针叶/红木主题块
406	    genRect(st, rng, [
407	      { k: 'dither', p: 0.95 },
408	      { k: 'onlyTiles', types: [T.WOOD, TILE_BY_KEY['v_321_boreal_wood']!, TILE_BY_KEY['v_158_rich_mahogany']!] },
409	      { k: 'clearTile' },
410	    ], r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
411	    return;
412	  }
413	  if (theme === 'ice') {
414	    // ① 321→161→147(IceHouseBuilder.cs:29):Dither(0.6)+Blotches(2,0.6)+
415	    //   OnlyTiles(321)+SetTileKeepWall(161)+Dither(0.8)+SetTileKeepWall(147)
416	    genRect(st, rng, [
417	      { k: 'dither', p: 0.6 }, B2(0.6), { k: 'onlyTiles', types: [def.tile] },
418	      { k: 'setTileKeepWall', tile: ICE161 },
419	      { k: 'dither', p: 0.8 }, { k: 'setTileKeepWall', tile: SNOW147 },
420	    ], r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
421	    // ② 顶/底行钟乳石(IceHouseBuilder.cs:30-31):Dither(0.5)+OnlyTiles(161)+
422	    //   Offset(0,1)+ActionStalagtite,矩形 (X+1, 行, W-2, 1)
423	    for (const rowY of [r.y, r.y + r.h - 1]) {
424	      genRect(st, rng, [
425	        { k: 'dither', p: 0.5 }, { k: 'onlyTiles', types: [ICE161] }, { k: 'offset', dx: 0, dy: 1 }, { k: 'stalagtite' },
426	      ], r.x + 1, rowY, r.w - 2, 1);
427	    }
428	    // ③ 墙(IceHouseBuilder.cs:32,无 OnlyWalls):Dither(0.85)+Blotches(2,0.8)+
429	    //   SkipTiles(画族)+清墙/铺墙 40
430	    genRect(st, rng, [{ k: 'dither', p: 0.85 }, B2(0.8), ...wallTail(40)], r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
431	    return;
432	  }
433	  if (theme === 'jungle') {
434	    // ① 158→60→59(JungleHouseBuilder.cs:29):Dither(0.6)+Blotches(2,0.6)+
435	    //   OnlyTiles(158)+SetTileKeepWall(60)+Dither(0.8)+SetTileKeepWall(59)
436	    genRect(st, rng, [
437	      { k: 'dither', p: 0.6 }, B2(0.6), { k: 'onlyTiles', types: [def.tile] },
438	      { k: 'setTileKeepWall', tile: JUNGLE60 },
439	      { k: 'dither', p: 0.8 }, { k: 'setTileKeepWall', tile: MUD59 },
440	    ], r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
441	    // ② 藤(JungleHouseBuilder.cs:30-31):Dither(0.5)+OnlyTiles(60)+Offset(0,1)+
442	    //   IsEmpty+ActionVines(3, H, 62)
443	    for (const rowY of [r.y, r.y + r.h - 1]) {
444	      genRect(st, rng, [
445	        { k: 'dither', p: 0.5 }, { k: 'onlyTiles', types: [JUNGLE60] }, { k: 'offset', dx: 0, dy: 1 },
446	        { k: 'isEmpty' }, { k: 'vines', min: 3, max: r.h, vine: VINE62 },
447	      ], r.x + 1, rowY, r.w - 2, 1);
448	    }
449	    // ③ 墙 64(JungleHouseBuilder.cs:32,无 OnlyWalls/SkipTiles)
450	    genRect(st, rng, [{ k: 'dither', p: 0.85 }, B2(0.3), { k: 'placeWall', wall: 64 }], r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
451	    return;
452	  }
453	  if (theme === 'mushroom') {
454	    // ① 190→70(MushroomHouseBuilder.cs:27):Dither(0.7)+Blotches(2,0.5)+OnlyTiles(190)
455	    genRect(st, rng, [
456	      { k: 'dither', p: 0.7 }, B2(0.5), { k: 'onlyTiles', types: [def.tile] },
457	      { k: 'setTileKeepWall', tile: MUSH70 },
458	    ], r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
459	    // ② 顶/底行(MushroomHouseBuilder.cs:28-29):Dither(0.6)+OnlyTiles(70)+
460	    //   Offset(0,-1)+IsEmpty+SetTile(71)
461	    for (const rowY of [r.y, r.y + r.h - 1]) {
462	      genRect(st, rng, [
463	        { k: 'dither', p: 0.6 }, { k: 'onlyTiles', types: [MUSH70] }, { k: 'offset', dx: 0, dy: -1 },
464	        { k: 'isEmpty' }, { k: 'setTile', tile: SHROOM71 },
465	      ], r.x + 1, rowY, r.w - 2, 1);
466	    }
467	    // ③ 墙清空(MushroomHouseBuilder.cs:30)
468	    genRect(st, rng, [{ k: 'dither', p: 0.85 }, B2(0.3), { k: 'clearWall' }], r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
469	    return;
470	  }
471	  if (theme === 'granite' || theme === 'marble') {
472	    // ① 369→368 / 357→367(GraniteHouseBuilder.cs:28 / MarbleHouseBuilder.cs:28):
473	    //   Dither(0.6)+Blotches(2,0.6)+OnlyTiles(主题块)+SetTileKeepWall(368/367)
474	    const to = theme === 'granite' ? GRANITE368 : MARBLE367;
475	    genRect(st, rng, [
476	      { k: 'dither', p: 0.6 }, B2(0.6), { k: 'onlyTiles', types: [def.tile] },
477	      { k: 'setTileKeepWall', tile: to },
478	    ], r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
479	    // ② 顶/底行(GraniteHouseBuilder.cs:29-30):Dither(0.8)+OnlyTiles(368/367)+
480	    //   Offset(0,1)+ActionStalagtite(名单外 no-op,但 Dither/PlaceTight 掷骰照耗)
481	    for (const rowY of [r.y, r.y + r.h - 1]) {
482	      genRect(st, rng, [
483	        { k: 'dither', p: 0.8 }, { k: 'onlyTiles', types: [to] }, { k: 'offset', dx: 0, dy: 1 }, { k: 'stalagtite' },
484	      ], r.x + 1, rowY, r.w - 2, 1);
485	    }
486	    // ③ 墙 180/178(GraniteHouseBuilder.cs:31 / MarbleHouseBuilder.cs:31)
487	    genRect(st, rng, [
488	      { k: 'dither', p: 0.85 }, B2(0.3), { k: 'placeWall', wall: theme === 'granite' ? 180 : 178 },
489	    ], r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
490	    return;
491	  }
492	  // desert
493	  // ① 396→396→397(DesertHouseBuilder.cs:31):Dither(0.8)+Blotches(2,0.2)+
494	  //   OnlyTiles(396)+SetTileKeepWall(396)+Dither(0.5)+SetTileKeepWall(397)
495	  //   ——第一段写 396 是原版字面(视觉 no-op),但第二道 Dither 的掷骰位置在此
496	  genRect(st, rng, [
497	    { k: 'dither', p: 0.8 }, B2(0.2), { k: 'onlyTiles', types: [def.tile] },
498	    { k: 'setTileKeepWall', tile: def.tile },
499	    { k: 'dither', p: 0.5 }, { k: 'setTileKeepWall', tile: HARDSAND397 },
500	  ], r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
501	  // ② 顶/底行钟乳石(DesertHouseBuilder.cs:32-33,曾整体缺失 C5):
502	  //   Dither(0.5)+OnlyTiles(397,396)+Offset(0,1)+ActionStalagtite
503	  for (const rowY of [r.y, r.y + r.h - 1]) {
504	    genRect(st, rng, [
505	      { k: 'dither', p: 0.5 }, { k: 'onlyTiles', types: [HARDSAND397, def.tile] },
506	      { k: 'offset', dx: 0, dy: 1 }, { k: 'stalagtite' },
507	    ], r.x + 1, rowY, r.w - 2, 1);
508	  }
509	  // ③ 墙 216(DesertHouseBuilder.cs:34):Dither(0.8)+Blotches()+OnlyWalls(187)
510	  genRect(st, rng, [
511	    { k: 'dither', p: 0.8 }, B2(0.3), { k: 'onlyWalls', types: [def.wall] }, { k: 'placeWall', wall: 216 },
512	  ], r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
513	}

515	// ---------- FillRooms(画/烛台交替 + 装饰循环) ----------
516	function fillRooms(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, r: Rect, def: ThemeDef, theme: Theme): void {
517	  // 家具七选(HouseBuilder.FillRooms choices;沙漠 Tables2 → tile 469)
518	  const choices: Array<[string, number]> = [
519	    [def.tables2 ? 'v_469_tables_group_2' : 'table', def.table],
520	    ['anvil', 0],
521	    ['workbench', def.workbench],
522	    ['v_86_loom', 0],
523	    ['piano', def.piano],
524	    ['keg', 0],
525	    ['bookcase', def.bookcase],
526	  ];
527	  // 画/烛台交替:switch(i + parity%2) 仅 0/1 两档有内容(i≥2 落空,原版同款)
528	  const n = Math.floor(r.w / 8);
529	  const step = Math.floor(r.w / (n + 1));
530	  const parity = rng.int(0, 1);
531	  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
532	    const x = (i + 1) * step + r.x;
533	    if ((i + (parity % 2)) % 2 === 0) {
534	      // 画:Y + min(H/2, H-5)
535	      const y = r.y + Math.min(Math.floor(r.h / 2), r.h - 5);
536	      const [key, style] = theme === 'desert' ? randHousePictureDesert(rng) : randHousePicture(rng);
537	      placeFurniture(st, key, x, y, style);
538	    } else {
539	      // 烛台:顶行悬挂(原版 +54 点亮帧——本引擎烛台恒点亮,帧差不建模)
540	      const y = r.y + 1;
541	      placeFurniture(st, 'candelabra', x, y, rng.int(0, 5), 'top');
542	    }
543	  }
544	  // 装饰循环:W/8+3 件
545	  const decoCount = Math.floor(r.w / 8) + 3;
546	  for (let k = 0; k < decoCount; k++) {
547	    const x = rng.int(0, r.w - 4) + 1 + r.x;
548	    const y = r.y + r.h - 2;
549	    switch (rng.int(0, 3)) {
550	      case 0: // 小堆 185(PlaceSmallPile size1:style*18)
551	        if (!activeAt(st, x, y)) st.setTileSilent(x, y, SMALL_PILE, rng.int(31, 33) * 18, 0);
552	        break;
553	      case 1: // 骨堆 186
554	        placeFurniture(st, 'v_186_decos_3x2', x, y, rng.int(22, 25));
555	        break;
556	      case 2: // 雕像(statueList[Next(2, len)],陷阱雕像照接)
557	        placeStatue(st, x, y, rng.int(2, STATUE_LIST.length - 1));
558	        break;
559	      case 3: {
560	        const [key, style] = choices[rng.int(0, choices.length - 1)];
561	        placeFurniture(st, key, x, y, style);
562	        break;
563	      }
564	    }
565	  }
566	}
567	
568	// ---------- 楼梯 / 门 / 平台 / 梁 ----------
569	/** CreateStairsList + PlaceStairs:相邻房间对角平台链 + 顶步 4×1 平台 + 斜坡 */
570	function placeStairs(st: TileStore, rooms: Rect[], def: ThemeDef): void {
571	  for (let i = 1; i < rooms.length; i++) {
572	    const cur = rooms[i], prev = rooms[i - 1];
573	    const leftGap = prev.x - cur.x;
574	    const rightGap = cur.x + cur.w - (prev.x + prev.w);
575	    let from: { x: number; y: number };
576	    if (leftGap > rightGap) from = { x: cur.x + cur.w - 1, y: cur.y + 1 };
577	    else from = { x: cur.x, y: cur.y + 1 };
578	    const steps = (cur.y + cur.h - 1) - from.y;
579	    const dir = leftGap > rightGap ? -1 : 1;
580	    for (let s = 0; s < steps; s++) {
581	      const sx = from.x + dir * (s + 1), sy = from.y + s;
582	      if (!st.inBounds(sx, sy)) continue;
583	      // 平台帧 = PlaceTile(19, PlatformStyle)(HouseBuilder.cs:518)——case 19 走
584	      // frameY = 18*style(WorldGen.cs:60245-60249),非 frameX;曾恒写 (0,0)(C6)
585	      st.setTileSilent(sx, sy, PLATFORM, 0, def.platformStyle * 18);
586	      st.slope[st.idx(sx, sy)] = dir === 1 ? 1 : 2;
587	    }
588	    // 顶步上方 4×1 平台(清空+补墙+平台,HouseBuilder.cs:519)
589	    const px = from.x + (dir === 1 ? 1 : -4);
590	    for (let dx = 0; dx < 4; dx++) {
591	      if (!st.inBounds(px + dx, from.y - 1)) continue;
592	      st.setTileSilent(px + dx, from.y - 1, PLATFORM, 0, def.platformStyle * 18);
593	      st.setWallSilent(px + dx, from.y - 1, def.wall);
594	    }
595	  }
596	}
597	
598	/** FindSideExit(Up 搜索 + AreaOr(4,3) 任一非实心) */
599	function findSideExit(st: TileStore, wallX: number, wallY: number, wallH: number, isLeft: boolean): number | null {
600	  const startX = wallX + (isLeft ? -4 : 0);
601	  for (let k = 0; k < wallH - 3; k++) {
602	    const y = wallY + wallH - 3 - k;
603	    let any = false;
604	    for (let dx = 0; dx < 4 && !any; dx++) {
605	      for (let dy = 0; dy < 3 && !any; dy++) {
606	        if (!solidAt(st, startX + dx, y + dy)) any = true;
607	      }
608	    }
609	    if (any) return y;
610	  }
611	  return null;
612	}
613	
614	function placeDoors(st: TileStore, rooms: Rect[], def: ThemeDef): void {
615	  for (const r of rooms) {
616	    // 墙列矩形 (X, Y+1, 1, H-2)
617	    // 门禁（原版 PlaceTile(x, exitY)→PlaceDoor(j+1)，WorldGen.cs:31946）：mount
618	    // （exitY-1 实心）+ 地板（exitY+3 实心）缺一即不放门只留门洞——HouseBuilder
619	    // 的 forced=true 仅绕过首道空格门，门分支的锚点条件仍生效
620	    const tryDoor = (x: number, exitY: number) => {
621	      for (let dy = 0; dy < 3; dy++) st.setTileSilent(x, exitY + dy, 0);
622	      if (solidAt(st, x, exitY - 1) && solidAt(st, x, exitY + 3)) {
623	        placeDoorClosed(st, x, exitY, def.door);
624	      }
625	    };
626	    const exitR = findSideExit(st, r.x + r.w - 1, r.y + 1, r.h - 2, false);
627	    if (exitR !== null) tryDoor(r.x + r.w - 1, exitR);
628	    const exitL = findSideExit(st, r.x, r.y + 1, r.h - 2, true);
629	    if (exitL !== null) tryDoor(r.x, exitL);
630	  }
631	}
632	
633	/** FindVerticalExit(Left 搜索 + AreaOr(3,5) 任一非实心) */
634	function findVerticalExit(st: TileStore, rectX: number, rectY: number, rectW: number, isUp: boolean): number | null {
635	  const startX = rectX + rectW - 3;
636	  const startY = rectY + (isUp ? -5 : 0);
637	  for (let k = 0; k < rectW - 3; k++) {
638	    const x = startX - k;
639	    let any = false;
640	    for (let dx = 0; dx < 3 && !any; dx++) {
641	      for (let dy = 0; dy < 5 && !any; dy++) {
642	        if (!solidAt(st, x + dx, startY + dy)) any = true;
643	      }
644	    }
645	    if (any) return x;
646	  }
647	  return null;
648	}

650	function placePlatforms(st: TileStore, rooms: Rect[], def: ThemeDef): void {
651	  const top = rooms[0], bot = rooms[rooms.length - 1];
652	  // 顶层顶壁(isUp:候选自壁上 5 格起);帧同楼梯(C6):HouseBuilder.cs:574
653	  //   PlaceTile(19, PlatformStyle) → frameY = 18*style
654	  const exitT = findVerticalExit(st, top.x + 2, top.y, top.w - 4, true);
655	  if (exitT !== null) {
656	    for (let dx = 0; dx < 3; dx++) st.setTileSilent(exitT + dx, top.y, PLATFORM, 0, def.platformStyle * 18);
657	  }
658	  if (rooms.length > 1) {
659	    const exitB = findVerticalExit(st, bot.x + 2, bot.y + bot.h - 1, bot.w - 4, false);
660	    if (exitB !== null) {
661	      for (let dx = 0; dx < 3; dx++) st.setTileSilent(exitB + dx, bot.y + bot.h - 1, PLATFORM, 0, def.platformStyle * 18);
662	    }
663	  }
664	}
665	
666	/** CreateSupportBeamList + PlaceSupportBeams:6→4 步长梁列,落下一房顶/实心 */
667	function placeSupportBeams(st: TileStore, rooms: Rect[], def: ThemeDef): void {
668	  const minX = Math.min(...rooms.map((r) => r.x));
669	  const maxX = Math.max(...rooms.map((r) => r.x + r.w)) - 1;
670	  let step = 6;
671	  while (step > 4 && (maxX - minX) % step !== 0) step--;
672	  for (let x = minX; x <= maxX; x += step) {
673	    for (let ri = 0; ri < rooms.length; ri++) {
674	      const r = rooms[ri];
675	      if (x < r.x || x >= r.x + r.w) continue;
676	      const bottom = r.y + r.h;
677	      let limit = 50;
678	      for (let rj = ri + 1; rj < rooms.length; rj++) {
679	        const r2 = rooms[rj];
680	        if (x >= r2.x && x < r2.x + r2.w) limit = Math.min(limit, r2.y - bottom);
681	      }
682	      if (limit <= 0) continue;
683	      let found = -1;
684	      if (limit < 50) found = bottom + limit; // 原版:num7<50 视为命中下一房顶
685	      else {
686	        for (let y = bottom; y < bottom + limit; y++) {
687	          if (solidAt(st, x, y)) { found = y; break; }
688	        }
689	      }
690	      if (found < 0) continue;
691	      const height = found - bottom;
692	      if (height > 1 && st.type[st.idx(x, bottom - 1)] !== PLATFORM) {
693	        for (let y = bottom; y < found; y++) st.setTileSilent(x, y, def.beam, 0, 0);
694	      }
695	    }
696	  }
697	}

699	// ---------- 主题专属件级联(PlaceBiomeSpecificPriorityTool / PlaceBiomeSpecificTool) ----------
700	/** HouseBuilder.cs:764-826/838-865/881-907 共形级联:逐房【底行 Y+H-2】先 10 次
701	 *  随机(Next(2,W-2)+X)再整行扫描;仅 Bast 有顶行 Y-1 兜底级联(:798-825)。
702	 *  任一命中即停(true = 放置成功,调用方据此递增计数)。
703	 *  旧实现是"rooms[0] 单发随机公式"——三级级联与逐房推进全部缺失(C7) */
704	function cascadePlace(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, rooms: Rect[], key: string, ceilingFallback: boolean): boolean {
705	  const tryRow = (r: Rect, y: number): boolean => {
706	    for (let t = 0; t < 10; t++) {
707	      if (placeFurniture(st, key, rng.int(2, r.w - 3) + r.x, y)) return true;
708	    }
709	    for (let x = r.x + 2; x <= r.x + r.w - 2; x++) {
710	      if (placeFurniture(st, key, x, y)) return true;
711	    }
712	    return false;
713	  };
714	  for (const r of rooms) if (tryRow(r, r.y + r.h - 2)) return true;
715	  if (ceilingFallback) {
716	    for (const r of rooms) if (tryRow(r, r.y - 1)) return true;
717	  }
718	  return false;
719	}
720	
721	// ---------- 宝箱四级联(PlaceChests) ----------
722	function placeChests(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, chests: ChestSink, rooms: Rect[], def: ThemeDef, theme: Theme): void {
723	  const tryAt = (x: number, y: number): boolean => {
724	    const underground = y > gs.worldSurface;
725	    // 冰屋：显式 style 11 直入冰箱门（cs:36107 第一析取）→ 主件池 + 1/20 提炼机 +
726	    // 1/50 鱼覆盖块自动生效（旧实现显式 loot 绕过覆盖——审计三.4 修复）
727	    return placeBuriedChest(st, rng, gs, chests, x, y, {
728	      style: underground ? def.chestStyle : 0,
729	      tile: underground && def.chestTile2 ? CHEST2 : undefined,
730	      flags: theme === 'ice' ? { ice: true } : (!underground ? { wooden: true } : {}),
731	    });
732	  };
733	  // 级联 1:各房底行随机 10 次
734	  for (const r of rooms) {
735	    const floorY = r.y + r.h - 1;
736	    let ok = false;
737	    for (let t = 0; t < 10 && !ok; t++) ok = tryAt(rng.int(2, r.w - 3) + r.x, floorY);
738	    if (ok) return;
739	    for (let x = r.x + 2; x <= r.x + r.w - 2 && !ok; x++) ok = tryAt(x, floorY);
740	    if (ok) return;
741	  }
742	  // 级联 2:各房顶行(Y-1)
743	  for (const r of rooms) {
744	    const ceilY = r.y - 1;
745	    let ok = false;
746	    for (let t = 0; t < 10 && !ok; t++) ok = tryAt(rng.int(2, r.w - 3) + r.x, ceilY);
747	    if (ok) return;
748	    for (let x = r.x + 2; x <= r.x + r.w - 2 && !ok; x++) ok = tryAt(x, ceilY);
749	    if (ok) return;
750	  }
751	  // 级联 3:房外 ±30 随机 1000 次
752	  for (let t = 0; t < 1000; t++) {
753	    if (tryAt(rng.int(rooms[0].x - 30, rooms[0].x + 29), rng.int(rooms[0].y - 30, rooms[0].y + 29))) return;
754	  }
755	}
756	
757	// ---------- pass 主体 ----------
758	/** 地下小屋 pass(UndergroundHousesAndBuriedChests 的 CaveHouse 段,cs:17153-17192
759	 *  + 沙漠追加段 cs:17193-17219) */
760	/** pass 59 头四计数连掷(cs:17081-17084,序=CaveHouse→Underworld→CaveChest→
761	 *  AdditionalDesert)——本仓 pass 拆分后各消费 pass 流位分散,由本函数在管线中
762	 *  第一个消费 pass 之前统一预掷暂存 gs(WorldGen.ts 接线)。四枚均为
763	 *  WorldGenRange.GetRandom(WorldGenRange.cs:34-57:先缩放边界再截断):
764	 *  CaveHouse/CaveChest=35-40×WorldArea、Underworld=10-15×WorldWidth/4200、
765	 *  AdditionalDesert=2-2×WorldArea(恒掷一骰)。幂等:已预掷(≥0)直接返回。 */
766	export function rollHouseChestCounts(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState): void {
767	  if (gs.caveHouseCount >= 0) return;
768	  const area = (st.w * st.h) / 5040000;
769	  const wsc = st.w / 4200;
770	  gs.caveHouseCount = rng.int(Math.trunc(35 * area), Math.trunc(40 * area));
771	  gs.underworldChestCount = rng.int(Math.trunc(10 * wsc), Math.trunc(15 * wsc));
772	  gs.caveChestCount = rng.int(Math.trunc(35 * area), Math.trunc(40 * area));
773	  gs.desertHouseCount = rng.int(Math.trunc(2 * area), Math.trunc(2 * area));
774	}
775	
776	export function runCaveHousesPass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, chests: ChestSink): void {
777	  // ★pass 头 tileSolid 翻转（cs:17076-17079）：226 蜥蜴砖/162 薄冰/225 蜂巢块/
778	  //   190 荧光菇块短暂回**实心**——本 pass 的房间寻找/锚定（findRoom 的 solidAt /
779	  //   HouseUtils.AreRoomsValid）把它们当可建地面。pass 尾（cs:17220-23）翻回 false。
780	  flipGenSolid([226, 162, 225, 190], true);
781	  const { w, h } = st;
782	  // CaveHouseCount 35-40 × WorldArea/5040000(Configuration.json)。WorldGenRange.
783	  // GetRandom(WorldGenRange.cs:34-40)= Next(ScaledMinimum, ScaledMaximum+1),
784	  // ScaleValue(:42-57)先按面积缩放边界再 (int) 截断——即
785	  // Next((int)(35*s), (int)(40*s)+1)。旧实现"先掷后乘 + Math.round",分布不同(C10)。
786	  // 另:原版 pass 头连掷四枚(cs:17081-17084:CaveHouseCount→UnderworldChestCount→
787	  // CaveChestCount→AdditionalDesertHouseCount);由 rollHouseChestCounts 在管线里
788	  // **先于**本 pass 统一预掷(WorldGen.ts 接线),本 pass 只消费 gs 暂存值
789	  // (探针直调未预掷时回退自掷)。
790	  const s = (w * h) / 5040000;
791	  const count = gs.caveHouseCount >= 0 ? gs.caveHouseCount : rng.int(Math.trunc(35 * s), Math.trunc(40 * s));
792	  // 第 4 个 WorldGenRange：AdditionalDesertHouseCount（2-2 × WorldArea，
793	  // Configuration.json）——GetRandom 恒消费一次 Next（cs:17084）
794	  const desertHouses = gs.desertHouseCount >= 0 ? gs.desertHouseCount : rng.int(2, 2);
795	  let bastCount = 0;        // GenVars.extraBastStatueCount
796	  // extraBastStatueCountMax(WorldGen.cs:11490-11499)= 2+尺寸档:大(≥8400)+2、
797	  // 中(≥6400)+1、小 +0——旧实现硬编码 2,仅小世界正确(C7)
798	  const bastMax = 2 + (w >= 8400 ? 2 : w >= 6400 ? 1 : 0);
799	  let extractCount = 0;     // HouseBuilderContext.ExtractinatorCount
800	  let sharpCount = 0;       // context.SharpenerCount
801	
802	  /** 单座小屋放置（HouseBuilder.Place 原序），返回是否成功 */
803	  const placeHouse = (ox: number, oy: number, oceanGate: boolean): boolean => {
804	    if (oceanGate && (ox < gs.beachDistance || ox > w - gs.beachDistance)) return false; // oceanDepths 回避
805	    // CaveHouseBiome.Place 前置拒绝(CaveHouseBiome.cs:36-54,C9 曾整体缺失):
806	    //   InWorld(origin,30) + 原点 ±25 内有红线或 BasicChest(21/467,TileID.cs:315)
807	    //   → 整屋放弃。须在 createRooms 之前(不耗 RNG)。
808	    if (ox < 30 || oy < 30 || ox >= w - 30 || oy >= h - 30) return false;
809	    for (let i = ox - 25; i <= ox + 25; i++) {
810	      for (let j = oy - 25; j <= oy + 25; j++) {
811	        const k = st.idx(i, j);
812	        if ((st.wire[k] & TileStore.WIRE_RED) !== 0) return false; // tile.wire()(红线位)
813	        const t = st.type[k];
814	        if (t === CHEST21 || t === CHEST2) return false;           // TileID.Sets.BasicChest
815	      }
816	    }
817	    const rooms = createRooms(st, rng, ox, oy);
818	    if (!rooms.length) return false;
819	    // 位置合法(InWorld 10 边距 / 底部 < h-220)+ 房间互不重叠
820	    let ok = true;
821	    for (const r of rooms) {
```

```
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace Terraria.GameContent.Biomes.CaveHouse;

public class WoodHouseBuilder : HouseBuilder
{
	public WoodHouseBuilder(IEnumerable<Rectangle> rooms)
		: base(HouseType.Wood, rooms)
	{
		base.TileType = 30;
		base.WallType = 27;
		base.BeamType = 124;
		base.PlatformStyle = 0;
		base.DoorStyle = 0;
		base.TableStyle = 0;
		base.WorkbenchStyle = 0;
		base.PianoStyle = 0;
		base.BookcaseStyle = 0;
		base.ChairStyle = 0;
		base.ChestStyle = 1;
		PotentiallyConvertToSeedHouse();
		PotentiallyConvertToRainbowBrick();
		PotentiallyConvertToRainbowMossBlock();
	}

	protected override void AgeRoom(Rectangle room)
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < room.Width * room.Height / 16; i++)
		{
			int x = WorldGen.genRand.Next(1, room.Width - 1) + room.X;
			int y = WorldGen.genRand.Next(1, room.Height - 1) + room.Y;
			WorldUtils.Gen(new Point(x, y), new Shapes.Rectangle(2, 2), Actions.Chain(new Modifiers.Dither(), new Modifiers.Blotches(2, 2), new Modifiers.IsEmpty(), new Actions.SetTile(51, setSelfFrames: true)));
		}
		WorldUtils.Gen(new Point(room.X, room.Y), new Shapes.Rectangle(room.Width, room.Height), Actions.Chain(new Modifiers.Dither(0.85), new Modifiers.Blotches(), new Modifiers.OnlyWalls(base.WallType), new Modifiers.SkipTiles(SkipTilesDuringWallAging), ((double)room.Y > Main.worldSurface) ? ((GenAction)new Actions.ClearWall(frameNeighbors: true)) : ((GenAction)new Actions.PlaceWall(2))));
		WorldUtils.Gen(new Point(room.X, room.Y), new Shapes.Rectangle(room.Width, room.Height), Actions.Chain(new Modifiers.Dither(0.95), new Modifiers.OnlyTiles(30, 321, 158), new Actions.ClearTile(frameNeighbors: true)));
	}

	public override void Place(HouseBuilderContext context, StructureMap structures)
	{
		base.Place(context, structures);
		RainbowifyOnTenthAnniversaryWorlds();
	}
}
```

```
454	/** AddBuriedChest（1456 cs:35920）下落/门禁段 1:1：
455	 *  自 j 向下扫至 k < maxTilesY-10，逐行检查 anyShimmer / 幼虫 231 → 整体失败；
456	 *  首个 SolidTile（半砖/坡面不算，WorldGen.SolidTile）落定。
457	 *  ±2 邻域（InWorld 100 边距）有 Boulders{138,484,664,665,711-716}/祭坛 26/蜥蜴祭坛 237 → 失败
458	 *  ——该检查在扫描循环内**逐行**执行（锚=当前行 k，cs:35992-36002），非仅起始行。
459	 *  notNearOtherChests:true 时经 Chest.NearOtherChests（±25×±8 已有箱）拒绝（cs:36253 透传）。
460	 *  样式/战利品解析与 2×2 放置沿用本仓库 rollChestLoot 管线。 */
461	export function placeBuriedChest(
462	  st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, chests: ChestSink,
463	  i: number, j: number, opts: { style?: number; tile?: number; loot?: number | string; flags?: ChestFlags; trySlope?: boolean; notNearOtherChests?: boolean } = {},
464	): boolean {
465	  // 下落到地面（cs:35931 `for k=j; k<maxTilesY-10; k++`）
466	  let gy = j;
467	  let slopeL = -1, slopeR = -1;   // trySlope 压平的坡度（失败时回填，cs:37567-37575）
468	  for (; gy < st.h - 10; gy++) {
469	    const k = st.idx(i, gy);
470	    if (st.liquid[k] > 0 && st.liquidType[k] === 4) return false;              // anyShimmer → 整体失败
471	    if (st.flags[k] && st.type[k] === LARVA) return false;                      // 幼虫 231 → 整体失败
472	    // ★±2 巨石/祭坛拒绝在扫描循环内**逐行**执行（cs:35992-36002，锚=当前行 k：
473	    //   InWorld(n,num6,100) && Boulders{138,484,664,665,711-716} || 26 || 237）。
474	    //   曾在进循环前以起始行 j 只查一次——起始行下方 2 格内的滚石/祭坛全部漏检
475	    for (let dx = -2; dx <= 2; dx++) {
476	      for (let dy = -2; dy <= 2; dy++) {
477	        const xx = i + dx, yy = gy + dy;
478	        if (xx < 100 || yy < 100 || xx >= st.w - 100 || yy >= st.h - 100) continue;
479	        const kk = st.idx(xx, yy);
480	        if (!st.flags[kk]) continue;
481	        const tt = st.type[kk];
482	        if (BOULDER_TILES.has(tt) || tt === ALTAR || tt === TALTAR) return false;
483	      }
484	    }
485	    if (solidTileHB(st, i, gy)) {
486	      // trySlope 门（cs:35951-35968）：style 17 时 ±30 盒内不得有箱/越界；
487	      // 压平 (i-1,gy)/(i,gy) 的顶坡供放置（失败时回填）
488	      if (opts.trySlope && opts.style === 17) {
489	        for (let l = i - 30; l <= i + 30; l++) {
490	          for (let m = gy - 30; m <= gy + 30; m++) {
491	            if (l < 5 || m < 5 || l >= st.w - 5 || m >= st.h - 5) return false;  // InWorld(l,m,5)
492	            const nk = st.idx(l, m);
493	            if (st.flags[nk] && (st.type[nk] === CHEST || st.type[nk] === CHEST2)) return false;
494	          }
495	        }
496	      }
497	      if (opts.trySlope) {
498	        if (st.slope[st.idx(i - 1, gy)] >= 1 && st.slope[st.idx(i - 1, gy)] <= 2) {
499	          slopeL = st.slope[st.idx(i - 1, gy)];
500	          st.slope[st.idx(i - 1, gy)] = 0;
501	        }
502	        if (st.slope[k] >= 1 && st.slope[k] <= 2) {
503	          slopeR = st.slope[k];
504	          st.slope[k] = 0;
505	        }
506	      }
507	      break;
508	    }
509	  }
510	  if (gy >= st.h - 10) return false;
511	  if (!solidTileHB(st, i, gy)) return false;
512	  // trySlope 失败回填（cs:37567-37575：仅压平过的格才恢复）
513	  const restoreSlopes = (): void => {
514	    if (slopeL > -1) st.slope[st.idx(i - 1, gy)] = slopeL;
515	    if (slopeR > -1) st.slope[st.idx(i, gy)] = slopeR;
516	  };
517	
518	  let tile = opts.tile ?? CHEST;
519	  let style = opts.style;
520	  const flags: ChestFlags = { ...(opts.flags ?? {}) };
521	  let mainId = 0;
522	  let mainKey: string | null = null;
523	  if (typeof opts.loot === 'string') {
524	    mainKey = opts.loot;
525	    mainId = vanillaIdOfKey(opts.loot) ?? 0;
526	    if (mainId === 0 && ITEM_BY_KEY[opts.loot] === undefined) mainKey = null; // 无效键丢弃
527	  } else if (opts.loot !== undefined) {
528	    mainId = opts.loot;
529	  }
530	  if (style === undefined) {
531	    if (gy > st.h - 205) {
532	      // 地狱箱:style 4 + 地狱武器序(cs:36158-36171)
533	      style = 4;
534	      flags.hell = true;
535	      if (!mainId) mainId = nextHellItem(gs);
536	    } else {
537	      style = gy >= gs.worldSurface + 25 ? 1 : 0;
538	      if (style === 0) flags.wooden = true;
```

```
"""hash→k 映射 + TileFrame/PlaceTile 事件对拍（B 段真值仲裁）。"""
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/dgu')
from pyur import UR

SEED = 9293480
K0, K1 = 14400, 158200

u = UR(SEED)
# 与 UR 相同的状态推进，同时增量计算 FNV——注意 SeedArray 是整组就地变化，
# 每掷后需重算整个数组哈希（56*4B），156k 掷 ≈ 35M 字节操作，可接受。
M = 0x7FFFFFFF
def fnv(sa, inext):
    h = 2166136261
    for v in sa:
        h = ((h ^ (v & 0xFF)) * 16777619) & 0xFFFFFFFF
        h = ((h ^ ((v >> 8) & 0xFF)) * 16777619) & 0xFFFFFFFF
        h = ((h ^ ((v >> 16) & 0xFF)) * 16777619) & 0xFFFFFFFF
        h = ((h ^ ((v >> 24) & 0xFF)) * 16777619) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    h = ((h ^ (inext & 0xFF)) * 16777619) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    h = ((h ^ ((inext >> 8) & 0xFF)) * 16777619) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    h = ((h ^ ((inext >> 16) & 0xFF)) * 16777619) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    h = ((h ^ ((inext >> 24) & 0xFF)) * 16777619) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    return h

sa = u.sa
h2k = {}
for k in range(K0):
    u.internal_sample()
# k = 已掷次数；hash 在掷完 k 次后的状态上取
for k in range(K0, K1):
    u.internal_sample()
    h2k[fnv(sa, u.inext)] = k + 1   # k+1 = 已消费 k+1 掷

import json
json.dump({str(v): k for k, v in h2k.items()}, open('/tmp/dgu/h2k.json', 'w'))
print('hashes:', len(h2k), 'k range:', K0 + 1, '-', K1)
```

```
import sys

def v16(b, i): return b[i*2] | (b[i*2+1] << 8)

def chests(typpath, actpath):
    t = open(typpath, 'rb').read()

    return out

def topleft(ch):
    """2x2 聚合：仅保留左上格。"""
    res = []
    for (x, y) in sorted(ch):
        if (x, y-1) in ch or (x-1, y) in ch:

        res.append((x, y, ch[(x, y)]))

            c[lt] += 1
            pair.append(lt)
```

```
// UR(9293480) 流指纹反解：找 N 使 reseed(seed)+N 掷后的 FNV(SeedArray+inext)
// 等于 passchain_x86.txt 的 pass 尾哈希 → 得各 pass 原版精确掷数。
const SEED = 9293480;
const TARGETS = {
  58: 0x135b4d80, 59: 0x32042896, 60: 0xbdbaa0d3, 61: 0xf4b97083,
  62: 0x1e37b312, 63: 0xdf78094c,
};

function makeRng(seed) {
  const sa = new Int32Array(56);
  // setSeed 1:1
  let num2 = (161803398 - Math.abs(seed)) | 0;
  sa[55] = num2;
  let num3 = 1;
  for (let j = 1; j < 55; j++) {
    const num4 = (21 * j) % 55;
    sa[num4] = num3;
    num3 = (num2 - num3) | 0;
    if (num3 < 0) num3 += 2147483647;
    num2 = sa[num4];
  }
  for (let k = 1; k < 5; k++) {
    for (let l = 1; l < 56; l++) {
      sa[l] = (sa[l] - sa[1 + ((l + 30) % 55)]) | 0;
      if (sa[l] < 0) sa[l] = (sa[l] + 2147483647) | 0;
    }
  }
  let inext = 0;
  const draw = () => {
    let num = inext + 1;
    if (num > 55) num = 1;
    let num22 = num + 21;
    if (num22 > 55) num22 -= 55;
    let num3 = (sa[num] - sa[num22]) | 0;
    if (num3 === 2147483647) num3--;
    num3 = (num3 + ((num3 >> 31) & 0x7fffffff)) | 0;
    sa[num] = num3;
    inext = num;
    return num3;
  };
  const hash = () => {
    let h = 2166136261 >>> 0;
    const mix = (v) => {
      v = v | 0;
      h = ((h ^ (v & 0xff)) * 16777619) >>> 0;
      h = ((h ^ ((v >> 8) & 0xff)) * 16777619) >>> 0;
      h = ((h ^ ((v >> 16) & 0xff)) * 16777619) >>> 0;
      h = ((h ^ ((v >> 24) & 0xff)) * 16777619) >>> 0;
    };
    for (let k = 0; k < 56; k++) mix(sa[k]);
    mix(inext);
    return h;
  };
  return { draw, hash };
}

const r = makeRng(SEED);
const found = {};
const MAX = 600000;
for (let n = 0; n <= MAX; n++) {
  const h = r.hash();
  for (const [pass, t] of Object.entries(TARGETS)) {
    if (h === t && !(pass in found)) found[pass] = n;
  }
  r.draw();
}
console.log('N per pass (draws after reseed):', found);
```

```
	public static bool PlaceObject(int x, int y, int type, bool mute = false, int style = 0, int alternate = 0, int random = -1, int direction = -1)
	{

		if (TileObject.Place(objectData))
		{

			{
				SoundEngine.PlaySound(0, x * 16, y * 16);
			}
		}

	}
```

```
224	  h = Math.imul(h ^ (x | 0), 0x27d4eb2d);
225	  h = Math.imul(h ^ (y | 0), 0x85ebca6b);

227	  h = Math.imul(h, 0x2c1b3c6d);
228	  h ^= h >>> 12;
229	  return (h >>> 0) / 4294967296;
230	}

232	// ── FastRandom（Terraria.Utilities/FastRandom.cs:7-88 一比一）─────────────────
233	// 48 位 LCG（Java Random 同族），与 UnifiedRandom 完全独立的第二条随机流。
234	// 原版世界生成里凡显式 `new FastRandom(seed).WithModifier(...)` 的掷骰走这里
235	// （DesertHive.PlaceClustersArea 的 shell 类型骰/0.25 门、光照等）——绝不可用
236	// RNG/UnifiedRandom 代替，否则流偏移不可查。光照系统的副本在
237	// src/lighting/FastRandom.ts（同源、API 子集），此处是世界生成权威实现。
238	const FR_MULTIPLIER = 25214903917n;
239	const FR_ADD = 11n;
240	const FR_MASK = 0xffffffffffffn; // 2^48 - 1
241	
242	export class FastRandom {
243	  private seed: bigint;
244	
245	  constructor(seed: bigint | number) {
246	    this.seed = (typeof seed === 'bigint' ? seed : BigInt(seed)) & FR_MASK;
247	  }
248	
249	  /** NextSeed(L85-88)：静态推进，不动自身状态 */

251	    return (seed * FR_MULTIPLIER + FR_ADD) & FR_MASK;
252	  }
253	
254	  /** WithModifier(ulong)(L27-30)：新实例种子 = NextSeed(m) ^ 原 Seed（不改自身） */
255	  withModifier(m: number | bigint): FastRandom {
256	    const mod = typeof m === 'bigint' ? m : BigInt(m);
257	    return new FastRandom(FastRandom.nextSeed(mod) ^ this.seed);
258	  }
259	
260	  /** WithModifier(int x, int y)(L32-35)：
261	   *  modifier = (ulong)(x + 2654435769u + ((long)y << 6)) + ((ulong)y >> 2)
262	   *  坑：C# 的 (ulong)y 是 64 位补码（负 y → 巨值再右移），不能写 JS 的
263	   *  `y >>> 0`（32 位截断）——DesertHive 的 hj=-20 行曾因此整行门骰错位 */
264	  withModifierXY(x: number, y: number): FastRandom {
265	    const u64y = BigInt(y) & 0xffffffffffffffffn;   // (ulong)y：64 位补码
266	    const mod = BigInt(x + 2654435769 + (y << 6)) + (u64y >> 2n);
267	    return this.withModifier(mod);
268	  }
269	
270	  /** NextBits(b)(L47-51)：前进一步并取高 b 位 */
271	  private nextBits(bits: number): number {
272	    this.seed = FastRandom.nextSeed(this.seed);
273	    return Number(this.seed >> BigInt(48 - bits));
274	  }
275	
276	  /** Next(max)(L63-78)（= Next(min,max) 的 range 部分）；2 的幂走快速路径，
277	   *  其余拒绝采样——溢出带判据 num <= 2^31-1-(max-1) 与原版 int32 回绕等价 */
278	  nextMax(max: number): number {
279	    if ((max & -max) === max) {
280	      // (int)((long)max * NextBits(31) >> 31)
281	      return Math.floor((max * this.nextBits(31)) / 2147483648);
282	    }
283	    for (;;) {
284	      const num = this.nextBits(31);          // [0, 2^31)
285	      const rem = num % max;
286	      if (num <= 2147483647 - (max - 1)) return rem;
287	    }
288	  }
289	
290	  /** NextDouble()(L58-61)：`(float)NextBits(32) * 4.656613E-10f`——两个坑：

293	   *  结果因此可落在 [-1,1)（原版事实，DesertHive 0.25 门直接消费） */
294	  nextDouble(): number {
295	    this.seed = FastRandom.nextSeed(this.seed);
296	    const raw = Number(this.seed >> 16n);
297	    const b32 = raw >= 2 ** 31 ? raw - 2 ** 32 : raw; // (int) unchecked 回绕
298	    return Math.fround(Math.fround(b32) * Math.fround(4.656613e-10));
299	  }
300	}
```

```
#!/bin/bash
# MonoKickstart Shell Script
# Written by Ethan "flibitijibibo" Lee

cd "`dirname "$0"`"

UNAME=`uname`
ARCH=`uname -m`

if [ "$UNAME" == "Darwin" ]; then
	export DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH=./osx/:$DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH

	if [ "$STEAM_DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES" != "" ] && [ "$DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES" == "" ]; then
		export DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES="$STEAM_DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES"
	fi
	
	if [ "$SteamClientLaunch" = "1" ] && [ "$ARCH" = "x86_64" ] && [ "$(sysctl -n sysctl.proc_translated 2>/dev/null || echo 0)" = "1" ]; then
		arch -arm64 ./TerrariaServer.bin.osx $@
	else
		./TerrariaServer.bin.osx $@
	fi
fi
```

```
# UnifiedRandom (.NET Random 语义) —— /tmp/dgsrc/UnifiedRandom.cs 1:1
class UR:
    def __init__(self, seed: int):
        sa = [0] * 56
        num = abs(seed) if seed != -2**31 else 2**31 - 1
        num2 = 161803398 - num
        sa[55] = num2
        num3 = 1
        for j in range(1, 55):
            num4 = 21 * j % 55
            sa[num4] = num3
            num3 = num2 - num3
            if num3 < 0:
                num3 += 2147483647
            num2 = sa[num4]
        for _k in range(1, 5):
            for l in range(1, 56):
                sa[l] -= sa[1 + (l + 30) % 55]
                if sa[l] < 0:
                    sa[l] += 2147483647
        self.sa = sa
        self.inext = 0

    def internal_sample(self) -> int:
        num = self.inext + 1
        if num > 55:
            num = 1
        num2 = num + 21
        if num2 > 55:
            num2 -= 55
        num3 = self.sa[num] - self.sa[num2]
        if num3 == 2147483647:
            num3 -= 1
        num3 = num3 + ((num3 >> 31) & 0x7FFFFFFF)
        self.sa[num] = num3
        self.inext = num
        return num3

    def sample(self) -> float:
        return self.internal_sample() * 4.656612875245797e-10

    def next(self, mn=None, mx=None):
        if mn is None:
            return self.internal_sample()
        if mx is None:
            return int(self.sample() * mn)
        return int(self.sample() * (mx - mn)) + mn


def samples_at(seed: int, k0: int, n: int):
    """返回从第 k0 掷开始的连续 n 个 raw internal_sample 值（0-based 掷序）。"""
    u = UR(seed)
    for _ in range(k0):
        u.internal_sample()
    return [u.internal_sample() for _ in range(n)]
```

```
	public static void TileFrame(int i, int j, bool resetFrame = false, bool noBreak = false)
	{
		if (i <= 5 || j <= 5 || i >= Main.maxTilesX - 5 || j >= Main.maxTilesY - 5 || Main.tile[i, j] == null)
		{
			return;
		}
		MapUpdateQueue.Add(i, j);
		try
		{
			Tile tile = Main.tile[i, j];
			if (!tile.active())
			{
				tile.halfBrick(halfBrick: false);
				tile.ClearBlockPaintAndCoating();
				tile.slope(0);
			}
			if (tile.liquid > 0 && Main.netMode != 1 && !generatingWorld)
			{
				Liquid.AddWater(i, j);
			}
			if (!tile.active())
			{
				return;
			}
			int type = tile.type;
			if (Main.tileFrameImportant[type])
			{
				if (!noBreak || TileID.Sets.Torches[type] || TileID.Sets.FrameImportantEchoCulling[type])
				{
					TileFrameImportant(i, j, type, tile, resetFrame);
				}
				return;
			}
			if (!Main.tileSolid[type])
			{
				switch (type)
				{
				case 49:
					CheckOnTable1x1(i, j, (byte)type);
					return;
				case 80:
					if (CheckCactus(i, j))
					{
						return;
					}
					break;
				}
				if (TileID.Sets.IsVine[type] && !CheckVines(i, j, type, tile))
				{
					return;
```

````
function wallFrameResetRoll(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, x: number, y: number): void {
  if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) return;
  const w = st.wall[st.idx(x, y)];
  if (w === 0) return;
  if (WALL_LARGE.has(w)) return;
  rng.int(0, 2);                    // Next(0,3)
  if (w === 21) rng.int(0, 1);      // Next(2)
}
case 'placeWall': {
  st.setWallSilent(x, y, s.wall);
  wallFrameResetRoll(st, rng, x, y);
  wallFrameResetRoll(st, rng, x + 1, y);
  wallFrameResetRoll(st, rng, x - 1, y);
  wallFrameResetRoll(st, rng, x, y - 1);
  wallFrameResetRoll(st, rng, x, y + 1);
  return applyChain(...);
}
case 'clearWall': {  // frameNeighbors=true variant (wood/ice AgeRoom)
  st.setWallSilent(x, y, 0);
  if (s.frame) { 4 neighbors wallFrameResetRoll }
  return applyChain(...);
}
```

		}
````

```
		}
		if (PrefixLegacy.ItemSets.Summon[type])
		{
			return PrefixLegacy.Prefixes.PrefixesForSummons;
		}
		if (PrefixLegacy.ItemSets.BoomerangsChakrams[type])
		{
			return PrefixLegacy.Prefixes.PrefixesForBoomeransAndChakrums;
		}
		if (PrefixLegacy.ItemSets.ItemsThatCanHaveLegendary2[type])
		{
			return PrefixLegacy.Prefixes.PrefixesForBoomeransAndChakrums_TerrarianYoyo;
		}
		if (IsAPrefixableAccessory())
		{
			return PrefixLegacy.Prefixes.PrefixesForAccessories;
		}
		return null;
	}

	private bool RollAPrefix(UnifiedRandom random, ref int rolledPrefix)
	{
		int[] rollablePrefixes = GetRollablePrefixes();
		if (rollablePrefixes == null)
		{
			return false;
		}
		rolledPrefix = rollablePrefixes[random.Next(rollablePrefixes.Length)];
		return true;
	}
```
